clean_description: Exhalation is a collection of nine short stories that explore deep philosophical questions and speculative ideas. The narratives range from a time-traveling merchant in ancient Baghdad to an alien scientist's discovery about the universe, each story tackling themes of choice, free will, and the nature of existence. The collection showcases Ted Chiang's ability to weave profound concepts into engaging narratives.
themes: choice, free will, existence, time travel, alternate realities
setting: various speculative contexts, including ancient Baghdad and alien worlds
